title: Wo Moula Raza Hai
body:
Woh Jis Ki Riza Khaliq-e-Akbar Ki Riza Hai.
Janat Ki Sand Jis Ki Ziyarat Ka Silla Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh Alam-e-Imkan Mein Nazir Ki Nazar Hai.
Oss Ko Mere Amal Ki Niyat Ki Khabar Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hone Se Bhi Pehle Jisay Hone Ka Pata Hai.
Dil Mosa-e-Kazim Se Yeh Kehta Hai Adab Se.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Pyar Mujhe Aap Ki Aoulad Mein Sab Se.
Lekin Teri Aoulad Mein Jo Maula Raza Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbar Bhi Hai Shabeer Bhi Sajjad Bhi Paihum.
Baqir Yehi Jafar Yehi Yeh Mosa-e-Kazim.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Satwaan Zahra Ko Pisar Haq Se Mila Hai.
Laya Woh Wilayat Ki Fiza Toos Mein Humrah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Gonja Fizaon Mein Ali Un Wali ULLAH.
Inn Ajmi Zabno Ko Ali Jis Ki Atta Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh Aaya Madad Ke Liye Jab Bhi Hai Pukara.
Sultan-e-Khurasan Hai Bas Ghous Hamara.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Ab Bhi Mogees-e-Saf-e-Arbab-e-Azza Hai.
Konain Mein Sab Nematein Karta Hai Yeh Taqseem.
<<DIVIDER>>
Our Loh Ke Likhe Mein Bhi Kar Sakta Hai Tarmim.
Jo Kar-e-Khuda Kartay Hoye Abad-e-Khuda Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dozakh Kisay Our Dena Hai Dada Ka Kisay Ishq.
Aoulad Kisay Milni Hai Milna Hai Kisay Rizq.
<<DIVIDER>>
Taqdeer Ki Takhti Pe Yeh Sab Jis Ne Likha Hai.
Bibi Ne Kaha Mang Le Tohfa Koi Hum Se.
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Ne Kaha Bibi Mujhe Khaliq Se Mila De.
Jo Tohfa Mujhe Qum Ki Kareema Ne Diya Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Tujh Se Dua Bas Yeh Meri Qadir-o-Rehman.
Maula Ke Muhibbon Ki Hoon Sab Mushkilein Aasan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh Jis Ke Tasadduq Yeh Mera Harf-e-Dua Hai.
Kya :MIR HASAN: Hai Teri Oqaat-o-Haqeeqat.
<<DIVIDER>>
De Kar Teri Naslon Mein Yeh Midhat Yeh Tilawat.
Woh Jis Ne Tujhey Laiq-e-Tazeem Kiya Hai.
author: Mir Hassan Mir
